title: Berry Chia Layered Pudding Tart
blurb: A set chia pudding base with a date crust and fresh berry topping, chilled until firm.
steps: Blend the dates with the water until you have a thick, sticky paste.
Press the date mixture firmly into the base of a 20cm round tin or dish, spreading it evenly to form a crust layer.
Stir the chia seeds into the grape juice and leave to stand for 10 minutes, then stir again to break up any clumps.
Set aside half the berries for the topping, then gently fold the remaining berries and honey through the chia mixture.
Pour the chia mixture over the date base and smooth the surface.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until the chia has set into a firm pudding layer.
Scatter the reserved fresh berries over the top just before serving.
